newsitem.title: UK: VLCC Soro to leave for Canada after repairs.
newsitem.headline: VLCC Soro to leave for Canada after repairs.

text.p: The very large crude carrier Soro, whose steering system was damaged by a freak wave off Scotland, is under repair and will depart for Canada in the next 48 hours, a shipping official said on Monday.
The Soro, carrying 283,793 tonnes of Norwegian crude, is currently at anchor in the river Clyde, said the official from the vessel's agents, Maritime Navigation Company.
The wind was force 11-12 when the 299,718 dwt, 1993-built vessel was damaged on March 2, 28 nautical miles from land.
